author: Francisco Anzola
attribution: Photo: Francisco Anzola, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:White_Veil_(249065403).jpeg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Target is the small hanging white lightbox at top left-centre, Manama souq street. Tiny TEL/FAX/P.O. BOX line under it not transcribed. Distractors: large yellow 'الحجاب الأبيض / WHITE VEIL' fascia (cut off at the left edge), 'الخواجة للعباءات' and Mustafa Alkunaizi Jewellery signs, mosque behind. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Francisco Anzola
attribution: Photo: Francisco Anzola, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Market_Street_(249065401).jpeg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Large yellow shop fascia, Manama souq; slogan lines 'Arabic Style & Indian Style / Silver 925', 'Special Ringmaker' badges and phone numbers not transcribed. Distractors: 'مشير للعطورات' perfume sign at left, AWAIS jewellery, JAMEELA / جميلة, FRESH FRUIT JUICE. Same street as c71326027 but a different target. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: FactFindersEnigma
attribution: Photo: FactFindersEnigma, CC0 1.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sign_at_the_Bahrain_International_Airport.jpg. License: http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/deed.en. Unmodified original.
notes: Night shot, red illuminated letters on a rough stone pylon with the state coat of arms, at Bahrain International Airport (Awal private lounge entrance). The Arabic is calligraphic with tashkeel (vowel marks) that are not transcribed; base letters only. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

notes: Green roundabout advance-direction sign beside a road; top block 'جنوب المنامة / Manama South', lower-right block 'شمال المنامة / Manama North', roundabout pictogram in the middle.

author: Francisco Anzola
attribution: Photo: Francisco Anzola, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/10345599@N03/39661268295. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Red illuminated fascia in Manama souq, seen at an angle mid-distance. A small Arabic line above the English and a tagline below are too small to read and are not transcribed. Distractors: SINAN Textiles & Tailoring hanging board, '...LORING / ...ch Coats' sign cut at top left, phone and e-mail text.

author: abcdz2000
attribution: Photo: abcdz2000, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/15543596@N05/2565005370. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Red Arabic rooftop letters on the curved facade of the Mercure Grand Hotel Seef, Manama, shot from below at a steep angle with heavy colour saturation. Only the first word is transcribed; the second word (left, smaller and foreshortened) is probably جراند (Grand) but is not read with certainty. No Latin text visible.

author: xiquinhosilva
attribution: Photo: xiquinhosilva, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/7138083@N04/54581433968. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Wayfinding bollard/delineator on the Pearling Path, Muharraq; text runs vertically (rotated 90 degrees), Arabic and English side by side with black dot ornaments. A second identical bollard in the background. Different sign design and wording (مسار, not طريق) from c69781121.
